visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a vibrant, 2D animated fast-food restaurant. A grumpy yellow cat wearing a red employee uniform and cap stands behind the counter. Another cat is visible from behind, waiting to order. (2) The perspective shifts to a food display shelf where metal tongs pick up various items. These include burgers, hot dogs, and pizza slices, all shaped like cute cat faces. (3) A hand scoops cat-shaped yellow French fries into a red container decorated with cat logos. The background is a yellow and white checkered pattern. (4) A yellow paw opens a pink refrigerator door to reveal rows of 'Soso-Cola' bottles. Each bottle features a black cat design. (5) A cat-shaped ice cream cone receives a scoop of pink strawberry ice cream. (6) The camera shows a complete meal tray including the burger, fries, cola, and ice cream being assembled. (7) A white and yellow cat character stares at the food tray with massive, shimmering eyes and an open mouth, expressing intense hunger and excitement. (8) The video concludes with graphic screens showing a circular 'FUMEANCATS FAST FOOD' logo and promotional text about an upcoming event in October.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-pitched, bouncy electronic synthesizer melody accompanied by a bright 'ding' bell chime. The BGM has a playful, high-energy rhythm. (2) As the tongs move, a sliding, rubbery 'shlick' sound effect is heard. This is followed by a crisp 'tink' as the objects are handled. (3) A series of rapid percussive 'thud' sounds signify the food being placed, synchronized with the rhythmic beat of the BGM. (4) A mechanical door opening sound occurs as the fridge is accessed. (5) A squelching, wet scooping sound follows the ice cream action. (6) When the character reacts, a glittering, high-pitched 'sparkle' SFX rises in volume. (7) A loud, energetic masculine vocal shout in a Japanese anime style (proclaiming 'Irasshaimase' or similar) punctuates the brand reveal. (8) The bouncy music continues with a final drum hit and a joyful melodic resolution as the promo text displays.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote 'Fumeancats' themed fast-food catnip toys and their availability at an upcoming cat expo in Nangang, Taipei. The video uses a cute, high-energy animation style to appeal to cat owners.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video focuses entirely on showcasing a specific brand's products (Fumeancats catnip toys) and provides event details for purchase.
